interactables.text: The [Socialite] lowers her sunglasses. 'I saw that camera crew guy — the nervous one with the giant headphones — dragging [huge black cases] through the garden. At like, [quarter to seven]. I thought it was weird.'
The Socialite's phone has a pool selfie timestamped [6:47 PM]. Visible in the blurry background: a [figure with large dark cases] moving along the garden path.
A production schedule left poolside. Under '7:00 PM — Crew Assignments:' it reads: '[D. Marsh — Library (audio setup)].' He was supposed to be in the Library at seven.
